liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (4 reviews): Reviewer found the opening Shakedown Street strong; Reviewer found the opening Shakedown Street pretty hot [13][17][22][23]
- **Standing On The Moon** (3 reviews): Reviewer found Standing on the Moon surreal; Reviewer says Standing on the Moon may give listeners chills [15][18][19]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): Reviewer says the first set smokes from Stagger Lee through Deal [17]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Reviewer calls Here Comes Sunshine wonderful [14]
- **New Speedway Boogie** (1 review): Reviewer praises Jerry's playing on New Speedway Boogie, as if he suddenly woke up [20]
- **I Want To Tell You** (1 review): Reviewer says I Want To Tell You was the encore and the listing should reflect that [21]

## Setlist highlights

- **I Want To Tell You**: rare: 7 archived performances [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-10-15.163536.sbd.miller.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 155 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1994-10-15.nak300.bleich.LMPP.96457.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 159 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: A tape flip after Black Throated Wind is crossfaded, and Space has a patch from 6:16 to 6:25 [4]
- **gd94-10-15.sbd.miller.27249.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 153 min; rated 3.29/5 by 7 [7]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sound quality is described as great [14]
- **gd94-10-15.nak300.wiley.8043.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 155 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [9]. Said about its sound: Audience recording made with Nakamichi mics; the reviewer says it sounds solid and the taper did a very good job [13]

## Around the show

- Attendee says the atmosphere inside the Garden felt unlike any other venue they saw the band play [17]
- Attendee had seen about twenty Garden shows since 1987 and missed the run's closing night [19]
- Reviewer calls this a nice 1994 Garden run, suggesting the venue energized Jerry [20]
- Attendee says Vinny joined the band and made the show fun [23]
- Reviewer saw the 10/1 show a few weeks earlier, which raised expectations this night [13]
- Reviewer finds this New Speedway among the closest 1990s versions to the 2/19/91 one, along with RFK '95 [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-10-15.163536.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 1, 2023; source: SBD > DAT (44.1k) [1]
- **gd1994-10-15.nak300.bleich.LMPP.96457.sbeok.flac16**: taped by John Bleich; transferred by SIRMick; source: Nak 300 shotguns > WMD-6 > mac [4]
- **gd94-10-15.sbd.miller.27249.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [7]. Also: Soundboard transfer from discs supplied by David Gans; the encore was placed at the end of set one to fit two discs [7]
- **gd94-10-15.nak300.wiley.8043.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Tim Wiley; source: Audience: Nakamichi 300 Shotguns [9]
